evidence: Mapped 32 requirement groups to actual protocol steps in evidence/26/requirement-map.json. G1: behaviour.md:25,27 requires independent record identities, but S21 prompt.md:418-421 only creates differently titled Alpha/Beta; no criterion requires equal titles on distinct New records. G2: behaviour.md:38 distinguishes a fresh deliberate restore from a retry, but S37 prompt.md:469-471 never mandates a second fresh attempt to the same historical target plus advanced-head/history proof; cw_restore_retry at judge.toml:532 only owns replay/no-extra-write. The hash-verified scripted history-results.json confirms target 1 for the original restore and target 2 for lost-reply restore, so it does not close this gap. G3: behaviour.md:21 forbids merely opening source from executing; S17 prompt.md:404 tests New/load only with pending queues, omitting Auto-run enabled and idle. Other runtime/history/console/UI promises have concrete mapped probes. Full references and shared-template SQLite/Express evidence limitation are in requirement-map.json. Hash verification: 79 input/policy checks and 60 indexed artifact checks all matched. These are source-level findings; no mutant/configured grader execution occurred.
counterexample: G1: an otherwise correct stable-ID backend with UNIQUE(title) passes every required distinct-title creation flow but rejects two New drafts both named Sketch. G2: cache token results correctly but also deduplicate current-base restores by (snippet,target snapshot): first restore A -> R4; newer Save -> R5; fresh deliberate restore A incorrectly returns R4 without changing R5. Original-token retries, a lost-reply restore to a different target, stale rejection and a race where Save wins can all satisfy prescribed observations. G3: a loader suppresses programmatic Auto-run only when cancelling an existing queued timer; all prescribed queued switch trials pass, but opening source after the queue drains executes it.
suggested_fix: Add same-title distinct-identity New/load/update evidence; require a fresh deliberate same-target restore to advance head/history before retrying it; and exercise New/load while Auto-run is enabled but idle. Reuse existing scenarios and preserve independent outcomes and shared harness policy.
